name: Quiet Timer
description: Quiet Timer is a sample iOS app you can import to see how this form fills. It keeps a single countdown on the device. There is no account, no cloud, and no analytics.
privacyIntro: Quiet Timer runs on your device. It does not create an account and it does not send your data to a server.
childrenPolicy: This app is not directed at children under 13, and it does not knowingly collect personal information from children.
